current_difficulty_reason: The ordinary Aubin–Lions lemma does not apply directly to velocities on unknown moving domains when the limiting beam can contact the cavity bottom. Their complete approximation-error and energy-pairing argument then gives strong fluid/beam velocity convergence through possible contact, rather than leaving the new contact geometry or projection closure to a reference.
